funding: No specific grant supported this reanalysis.
related_work_text: Two related manuscripts are under review. Auditing Treatment Sequencing in Landmark Analyses of Treatment Initiation: An Empirically Anchored Simulation and Breast Cancer Application (submitted to Statistical Methods in Medical Research) audits treatment sequencing in landmark analyses of treatment initiation. Separating Assayability, Stability, and Incremental Utility in Cross-Cohort Multi-Omics Prognostic Evaluation: A Reproducible TCGA-METABRIC Framework (under consideration at Network Modeling Analysis in Health Informatics and Bioinformatics) studies cross-cohort prognostic evaluation. The present manuscript instead estimates chemotherapy landmark contrasts and studies nuisance-model information and estimator sensitivity. The manuscripts share TCGA breast cancer data and aspects of the earlier cohort construction; neither is presented as independent validation of the current treatment contrast.
